claim: In the Winterlands, fields can only be placed inside a Greenhouse's glass-covered area: a Cabbage field inside is accepted, the same field on open snow is refused. The Winterlands Field menu offers Cabbage (yield 1, 4 days), Beet (yield 2, 7 days) and Potato (yield 3, 9 days); Winter Pine is the only tree and there is no fruit tree menu.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 26 October 2026: research repo kellan/outlanders2-research, branch codex/playtest-observations (commits 572d8eb, 45125e9, 4b3a6c7), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md entry "Winterlands crops and Greenhouse placement rule (A5)". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/planters/ (planters-1-cabbage-inside-valid, planters-1-cabbage-outside-invalid, planters-1-winterlands-fields, planters-1-winterlands-trees).
